blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Pinned reads on 2026-10-01 at Ethereum block 26095798, Arbitrum block 510584190, Base block 52024118, and Plasma block 33896599 supersede the July satellite role observations. Current satellite OToken 1.1 implementations restrict mint and arbitrary-holder burn to immutable OAdapter 0xffb20098fd7b8e84762eea4609f299d101427f24, rather than BRIDGE_ADMIN_ROLE. Nonpersistent burn(address,uint256) calls with amount zero succeeded from that adapter and reverted Not authorized from the old DEFAULT_ADMIN Safe on all three satellites. The old role-grant burn path is historical, not current. The adapter's holder-balance burn capability remains adverse access evidence. Arbitrum's current verified StakedUSDai 1.13 implementation 0xef07186d90ca00107c4fc73a6fbfcb5ec3d3860d still checks USDai.isBlacklisted for caller, sender, and recipient. reviewedStatus remains true; no holder protection is inferred from the satellite change.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Canonical sUSDai issuance is native to the USDai-backed Arbitrum vault. Ethereum, Base, and Plasma use LayerZero OAdapter burn/mint representations. Their current OToken 1.1 implementations restrict mint/burn to an immutable adapter; the former grantable BRIDGE_ADMIN_ROLE path is historical. The chain-local DEFAULT_ADMIN Safe is 3-of-3 on Ethereum and Base and 3-of-4 on Plasma. Bridge controls remain separate from canonical Mint Authority.
